items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWER] Do they have any other benefits other than for death? Dariel?

ctx.x: President, secretary, treasurer, finance secretary. Then they have the board. Twelve members in the board.
Do they have any other benefits other than for death? Dariel?
They passed that in the meeting sometime. Our union, we get a deathier wife, get a thousand dollars. That's in town.
